author: DamiLee
description:
The hidden city inside Minas Tirith that most people never notice — a narrow corridor wedged against the mountain, no light, no sound, just the tombs of kings pulling you somewhere between the living and the dead.

Tolkien's version of Rath Dinen, the Houses of the Dead, is nothing like what the movie shows. The film gives you a dramatic bridge and a burning pyre. The books give you something far more unsettling: a sealed world, walled on one side, mountain on the other, where silence does something to you.

That gap between the two versions is exactly what this short explores.

title: Minas Tirith's Hidden City of the Dead
